schema.text: When you use public transport, which of these situations make you feel unsafe? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians
Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossings or lighting

en.#When you use public transport, which of: When you use public transport, which of these situations make you feel unsafe? (Select all that apply)
en.#Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders o: Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians
en.#Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossin: Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossings or lighting

it.#When you use public transport, which of: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, quali di queste situazioni ti fanno sentire in pericolo? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders o: Comportamenti pericolosi di chi guida, di chi pedala o di chi va a piedi
it.#Conflicts with other road users: Conflitti con altre persone in strada
it.#Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossin: Mancanza di fermate, attraversamenti o illuminazione sicuri e adeguati
it.#No emergency services nearby: Nessun servizio di emergenza nelle vicinanze

fr.#When you use public transport, which of: Lorsque vous prenez les transports en commun, lesquelles de ces situations vous font vous sentir en danger ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Mauvaise visibilité ou champ de vision limité
fr.#Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders o: Les comportements dangereux de personnes qui conduisent, qui roulent ou qui marchent
fr.#Conflicts with other road users: Conflits avec d’autres personnes qui circulent
fr.#Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossin: Le manque d’arrêts, de passages ou d’éclairage sûrs et adaptés

de.#When you use public transport, which of: Welche dieser Situationen geben Ihnen bei Fahrten mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln ein unsicheres Gefühl? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders o: Unsicheres Verhalten von Fahrenden oder zu Fuß Gehenden
de.#Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossin: Fehlende sichere oder geeignete Haltestellen, Überwege oder Beleuchtung

tr.#When you use public transport, which of: Toplu taşıma kullanırken bu durumlardan hangileri kendinizi güvensiz hissetmenize neden oluyor? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Kötü görüş veya sınırlı görüş mesafesi
tr.#Conflicts with other road users: Diğer yol kullanıcılarıyla tartışma ya da sürtüşme
tr.#Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossin: Güvenli veya yeterli durak, geçit ya da aydınlatma eksikliği

fa.#When you use public transport, which of: هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی، کدام یک از این موقعیت‌ها باعث می‌شوند احساس ناامنی کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: دید ضعیف یا میدان دید محدود
fa.#Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders o: رفتار ناایمن رانندگان، موتورسواران و دوچرخه‌سواران یا عابران پیاده
fa.#Conflicts with other road users: برخورد و تعارض با سایر کاربران راه
fa.#Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossin: نبود ایستگاه، گذرگاه یا روشنایی ایمن و کافی

hu.#When you use public transport, which of: Tömegközlekedés közben mely helyzetek miatt érzi magát veszélyben? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Rossz látási viszonyok vagy korlátozott beláthatóság
hu.#Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders o: A járművezetők, kerékpárosok, motorosok vagy gyalogosok veszélyes viselkedése
hu.#Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossin: A biztonságos vagy megfelelő megállók, átkelőhelyek vagy világítás hiánya
hu.#No emergency services nearby: Nincs a közelben mentő- vagy sürgősségi szolgálat

ar.#When you use public transport, which of: عند استخدام النقل العام، أي من هذه المواقف يجعلك تشعر بعدم الأمان؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: ضعف الرؤية أو محدودية مجال النظر
ar.#Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders o: سلوك غير آمن من السائقين أو الراكبين أو المشاة
ar.#Lack of safe or adequate stops, crossin: غياب محطات أو معابر أو إضاءة آمنة وكافية
